title: Close review #779: run the in-memory mutation check of the positive guard and the literal pin check
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix. Review #779 found the #763 finding 5 correction CLEAR on expected values and pins, but conditional on one item it could not execute (Bash was disabled): the in-memory mutation check. Run only that item and the literal Verification command. Expected gain: an unconditional CLEAR or a NOT-CLEAR in `.session/report.md`, which closes or reopens the zero-execution scorer scope for the next shaper. Do NOT re-derive the expectation, do NOT re-review findings 1-6, do NOT re-check pins beyond the Verification command. No session can run LabVIEW; claim no LabVIEW behaviour.

## Acceptance
- [ ] run the Verification command first, as written, and record its exact output
- [ ] write a small helper script to `.session/artifacts/mutation_check.py` (no repository writes) that loads benchmark/scripts/score.py by guarded exec or import, loads each of the two fixtures in memory, changes one `expected_positive` per_id correctness value of `positive-control` (benchmark/challenges/library-specialty.json) and of `extra-true-answer` (benchmark/challenges/library-icon-tests.json), and calls the self-test (`regression_self_test`, score.py around lines 283-349)
- [ ] record per control: unmutated self-test passes; mutated self-test raises (exception type and message, short)
- [ ] record the commit tested (git rev-parse HEAD) and the sha256 of both fixtures
- [ ] verdict CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR in `.session/report.md`; script output in `.session/artifacts/mutation-output.txt`; no repository writes, do not run score.py main()

## Verification
python3 -c "import hashlib,glob;F=['benchmark/challenges/library-icon-tests.json','benchmark/challenges/library-specialty.json'];B={f:open(f,'rb').read() for f in F};assert all(b'expected_positive' in B[f] for f in F);H={f:(hashlib.sha256(B[f]).hexdigest(),hashlib.sha1(b'blob %d'%len(B[f])+bytes(1)+B[f]).hexdigest()) for f in F};T={p:open(p).read() for p in glob.glob('benchmark/**/*.json',recursive=True) if p not in F};bad=[(p,f) for p in T for f in F if f in T[p] and not any(h in T[p] for h in H[f])];assert not bad,bad;print('fixture pins OK')"

## Context
Review #763 finding 5; correction #766 finished by #778 (merged 582b0afe); review #779 partial (report says CLEAR except the unexecuted mutation check). The same order in iteration 0177 (#782) never started: record 0177 shows 0 turns, no status, no branch. This is that order again, not a repeat of completed work. Lesson #743/#747: long inline python one-liners stall; use a file-based helper; guarded exec worked.

## Budget
Read only benchmark/scripts/score.py lines 250-360 and the `positive-control` / `extra-true-answer` entries of the two fixtures via Grep context. No whole large JSON files. Run Bash commands early (Bash loss late in session recurs: #718/#722/#754/#779). Short command output; report early.
